metadata.art_direction: Common wet timber, newer with restrained handling wear; old timber has desaturated grain, localized edge splinters and real lengthwise checks.

clearance.scope: Fixed frame has no moving leaf; no motion sweep was evaluated.

metadata.damage_policy: Age controls real local edge loss and shallow grain-aligned checks independently of wetness. All six states reuse the same supporting frame per family.
metadata.finish_portability: Wet color darkening and roughness variation bake into PBR maps. No runtime-only moisture shader, droplets, or animation is required.
metadata.grasp_policy: Not applicable: fixed glazing has no moving leaf or hand-grasp interaction.
metadata.orientation_convention: Socket/grip basis columns x,y,z are orthonormal right-handed axes in node-local coordinates. Socket normal equals basis.z (outward mounting normal, or hinge pin insertion axis); grip basis.x follows grasp bar and basis.z is outward surface normal. Grip approach is -basis.z. HandleBack rotation_z is pi. Transform axes by owning node rotation for world space.
metadata.physics_policy: Authoring geometry and support references only. Engine owns joints, strength, collision and all interaction mechanics.
metadata.socket_coverage_convention: Glass footprint is the full pane cut size, opening is visible clear width/height. support_part_ids identifies both sets of retaining beads. Existing glass and the modeled stop pocket are 4 mm thick. The replacement interface is capped at 4 mm; no adjustable-stop mechanism is modeled.
metadata.source_geometry: Original procedural geometry; no imported assets
metadata.support_policy: Glass sits in a two-sided stop/rebate pocket with 1 mm clearance from structural timber. Front/back retaining beads overlap all four edges by 11 mm; no floating fragments.
metadata.uv_convention: Orthonormal metric planar projection per surface. Coplanar triangulated caps share a common basis. Coordinates are meters and intentionally not packed into 0..1.

wood_damage.policy: Localized outer-edge loss and shallow checks parallel to grain; no structural fracture or strength model
